findings.measure: constitutional qualifications

House.residence: inhabitant of state when elected, no federal minimum duration

Senate.residence: inhabitant of state when elected, no federal minimum duration

findings.dualOffice: Article I section 6 prohibits a U.S. office-holder from simultaneously serving in Congress; state/local incompatibility needs separate law.
findings.sourceTerms: U.S. Constitution: public-domain government edict; federal transcription; facts only.

findings.measure: regular municipal election dates
findings.rule: Even-numbered years; first election second-to-last Tuesday in July starting 2026; general/runoff first Tuesday after first Monday in November; single-round elections in November. Special vacancy and recall elections excluded from regular-candidate rule.
findings.sourceTerms: Enacted statute only: government edict. Site layout and other web content excluded.

findings.measure: town election frequency
findings.rule: Annual town meeting elects moderator, select board and school committee. Section 2525 itself sets no uniform month; read town records rather than infer November.
findings.sourceTerms: Enacted statute only: government edict; editorial content excluded.

findings.measure: resign-to-run
findings.rule: 99.012(3) requires resignation for another overlapping state, district, county or municipal term; resignation irrevocable, submitted at least 10 days before qualifying starts, effective by the earlier statutory start/take-office date. Exceptions and federal candidacy must be checked in current subsection text; no nationwide automatic resignation rule.
findings.sourceTerms: Enacted statute only: government edict; factual paraphrase, no proprietary annotations.

gaps.finding: 2026 congressional dates cannot prove future primary dates or other office deadlines. Best usable baseline is the observed 2026 office-specific date; do not apply to legal eligibility in a later cycle. No defensible universal statutory numeric estimate.

gaps.scope: local five-kind sample in each state
gaps.finding: Not completed in this bounded pass. Municipal date, stagger and term rules must be read from the local charter and state instrument; population alone cannot identify law.

gaps.scope: petitions, invalidation, recounts, certification, guides, state qualifications and limits
gaps.finding: No complete first-party 56-place table established. Existing candidate-filing-terms.json is expressly estimated and must not be treated as sourced law. No source-supported nationwide invalid-signature rate was found.

termsQuestions: Candidate guides contain explanatory prose beyond government edicts; state-site reuse terms not established. No guide prose adopted.
Georgia legislature PDF is a 2025 supplement with LexisNexis annotations, not a read of complete current 21-2-9; do not adopt its editorial text.
interpretation: Aggregate observations calibrate totals; they do not choose an individual actor outcome. Legal rules apply only to the stated jurisdiction and vintage. Missing coverage is not legal permission. No excluded source or real-person name is included.
